effect_description_eng:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may place up to 4 level 5 or lower [Argomon] from your trash as this Digimon's bottom digivolution cards. Then, delete up to 4 levels' total worth of your opponent's Digimon. For every 2 [Argomon] in this Digimon's digivolution cards, add 1 to this level deletion effect's maximum.
[All Turns] This Digimon gets +1000 DP for every 2 [Argomon] in its digivolution cards.
[Opponent's Turn] None of your opponent's Tamers can unsuspend.
